name: HyperKvasir: Comprehensive Multi-Class Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Dataset
description: HyperKvasir is the largest publicly accessible multi-class image and video dataset for gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy, published in Nature Scientific Data by Simula Research Laboratory and Bærum Hospital, Norway. The collection aggregates 110,079 images and video frames obtained during real-world colonoscopy and gastroscopy examinations. It encompasses 10,662 labeled images organized into 23 distinct clinical findings across anatomical landmarks, pathological findings (polyps, ulcerative colitis, esophagitis, Barrett's esophagus), therapeutic interventions, and quality-of-preparation stages; 99,417 unlabeled endoscopy frames; 1,000 segmented polyp images with pixel-level ground-truth masks; and 374 video sequences total.
